title: Regional, Rural and Remote Emergency Medicine Conference 2027
about: Call for abstracts for ACEM's Regional, Rural and Remote Emergency Medicine Conference 2027 (RRR EM27), 18-20 July 2027 at Hotel Grand Chancellor Hobart, Tasmania. Six categories, including scientific papers and case studies; abstracts close 22 February 2027.
card_alt: Card for the Regional, Rural and Remote Emergency Medicine Conference 2027 by the Australasian College for Emergency Medicine (ACEM), in Hobart, Australia, abstracts due 22 Feb 2027. The photo is not of Hobart: it shows the Sydney Opera House and Harbour Bridge in Sydney at dusk.
